QUOTE: The send is never retried automatically, so it is attempted exactly once. ... It sends `noRetry: true` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-48`), and `buildRequestOptions` maps that to `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states the create-post request is never retried automatically and sent once, with the noRetry mechanism.
